cause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 inherited the PowerShell 7 module path and failed to load its diagnostics module. The previous reader suppressed the error and returned NaN.
fix: Import the diagnostics module from the child shell's PSHOME; validate process-only JSON readings; expose errors; retain unknown coverage after missed samples; recover late baselines; sample once at shutdown.
limitations: This is a bounded live-counter check with small CUDA allocations, not a training benchmark or an induced spill test.
Shared allocation growth is a proxy, not direct proof of physical paging; sampling can miss inter-sample excursions.
Historical unavailable readings remain unknown and were not rewritten.
Pre-existing lint findings in benchmark.py, copy_train.py and sidecar_train.py are unchanged; modified telemetry code introduces no new findings.
